testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: For text-only Frank routes, HTTP 200 plus finish_reason=stop is insufficient; a nonblank normalized assistant payload is required before VERIFIED/DONE.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Transport success and terminal finish reason are sufficient even when visible content is whitespace-only.
testable_hypotheses.test: Execute an adapter matrix over empty, spaces, tabs, newlines, Unicode whitespace, tool-only, refusal and ordinary text responses; require explicit route-specific outcomes and no effect commitment before admissible content.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: A whitespace-only response is safely and intentionally consumable by an authorized downstream route, or the policy rejects a valid non-text terminal route that was explicitly admitted.

testable_hypotheses.hypothesis: A current-PR credit receipt must atomically bind the PR object response, repository identity, head SHA, resolvable commit, workflow head_sha, job steps and verdict.
testable_hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A committed supervisor statement plus separately observed workflow metadata is sufficient.
testable_hypotheses.test: Produce one freshness-bounded raw receipt, immediately replay it through a second authenticated path and reject the entire credit unit if any referent differs.
testable_hypotheses.falsifier: Credit remains reproducibly sound despite an unresolved or contradictory PR head.
